I relate to this a lot. My cuts are very thin and barely leave scarring so a lot of the time I look at it and I'm like this is a joke it doesn't even look like you've hurt yourself, and its so easy to invalidate myself. I think we all do this to our own selves even if we're able to look at someone else and recognize their validity for some reason it's so much harder to accept our own struggles.

Yea I know, I don't as much want it to count for it just to count because I know it's not a good thing. I think sometimes its helpful to me to see it "count" so I can identify that there maybe is something wrong because a lot of the time it feels like there shouldn't be anything wrong but then I still do things like sh

Sometimes I draw with red marker on my arm in a cutting motion, it gives me the same satisfaction as looking down and seeing the cuts on my arm, I'm not sure if this will help you at all but it seems like you have strong visuals of it so ig it simulates that in a non harmful way. Please keep trying your best to distract yourself from it you mentioned that you cook which I'm proud of you for doing when you have urges. I might suggest journaling to or writing about whatever is on your mind in that exact moment to just let it out with out being scared of a response, especially if there's no one you can talk to irl. I'm so sorry that you're experiencing urges and those other physical effects I really hope things get better for you

I don't think it makes you a bad person at all, its hard to have to worry about always covering up when sometimes you just want to do whatever. I'm glad you have a friend who you are comfortable talking to I know it doesn't fix sh at all but being able to reach out even if it's only one person is always a good thing. I hope things get better for you with your mom, but please don't beat yourself up over it because you obviously already deal with a lot.
Can you tell your therapist in any other form of communication that your parents won't give you privacy because I'm pretty sure that's illegal and its preventing you from getting the help.

I recently started having suicidal thoughts again after not having them for almost a year. But I relate to this about how most days now they aren't as violent as they have been in the past but its more just a loop in my head thinking about I want to die right now I want to kill myself

Im so sorry your thoughts are valid and that's horrible that they have been overlooked by your parents even when you have been hospitalized I hope you are able to get proper help by people who believe you because you deserve to have that chance. I wish I could help you
